<style media="screen">
/* lightbox */
.lightbox-window {
position: fixed;
background-color: rgba(50, 50, 50, 0.95);
top: 0;
right: 0;
bottom: 0;
left: 0;
z-index: 99999;
visibility: hidden;
opacity: 0;
pointer-events: none;
transition: all 0.3s;
}
.lightbox-window:target {
visibility: visible;
opacity: 1;
pointer-events: auto;
}
.lightbox-window > div {
width: 1200px;
max-width: 70%;
max-height: 90%;
position: absolute;
top: 50%;
left: 50%;
transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
}
.lightbox-close{
position: absolute;
right: 15px;
text-align: center;
top: 10px;
}
@media (max-width: 575.98px) {
.lightbox-window > div{
max-width: 95%;
}
.lightbox-close img{
width: 1rem;
height: 1rem;
}
}
/* mockupy w ofercie - animacje na scroll */
.img-rotate {
position: absolute;
top: -5rem;
right: 5rem;
transform: rotate(var(--r));
transition: transform 0.1s linear;
will-change: transform;
}
.img-rotate2 {
position: absolute;
top: -15%;
right: 3%;
transform: rotate(var(--rr));
transition: transform 0.1s linear;
will-change: transform;
}
.img-fadein{
position: absolute;
right: 50%;
top: 50%;
transform: translate(50%,-50%);
max-width: 150%;
z-index: -1;
display: block;
margin: 0 auto;
opacity: var(--o);
transition: opacity 0.1s linear;
will-change: opacity;
}
.img-fadein2{
position: absolute;
left: 50%;
top: 50%;
transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
max-width: 130%;
z-index: -1;
display: block;
margin: 0 auto;
opacity: var(--oo);
transition: opacity 0.1s linear;
will-change: opacity;
}
.img-fadein3{
position: absolute;
transform: translateX(-50%);
left: 50%;
bottom: 0;
width: 90%;
z-index: -1;
display: block;
margin: 0 auto;
animation: scale-up-down 2s linear infinite alternate;
}
.img-iskry{
position: absolute;
transform: translateX(-50%);
left: 50%;
bottom: 0;
width: 90%;
z-index: -1;
display: block;
margin: 0 auto;
animation: elfadeIn 2s linear infinite alternate;
}
.img-fadeup{
position: absolute;
bottom: -3%;
left: 30%;
transform: translateY(var(--ty));
transition: transform 0.1s linear;
will-change: transform;
}
.img-fadeup2{
position: absolute;
bottom: -2%;
left: 30%;
transform: translateY(var(--yy));
transition: transform 0.1s linear;
will-change: transform;
}
.img-faderight{
position: absolute;
bottom: 0;
right: 0;
width: 12rem;
transform: translateX(var(--tx));
transition: transform 0.1s linear;
will-change: transform;
}
.img-fadeleft{
position: absolute;
bottom: 0;
left: 0;
width: 16rem;
transform: translateX(var(--xx));
transition: transform 0.1s linear;
will-change: transform;
}
/* menu z ikonkami */
.candy-offer-menu .candy-offer-icon{
height: 2.5rem;
width: auto;
object-fit: contain;
display: block;
margin: 0 auto;
margin-bottom: 1rem;
transition: all .5s;
}
.candy-offer-box{
border: 1px solid #E5E5E5;
border-radius: 5px;
padding: 12px 5px;
transition: all .5s;
}
.candy-offer-icon-white{
height: 2.5rem;
width: auto;
object-fit: contain;
display: block;
margin: 0 auto;
margin-bottom: 1rem;
display: none;
opacity: 0;
transition: all .5s;
}
.candy-offer-box-text{
font-size: 12px;
font-weight: 600;
text-transform: uppercase;
line-height: 1.4;
margin-bottom: 0;
}
.candy-offer-link:hover .candy-offer-box{
border: 1px solid #F9A71F;
background: #F9A71F;
color: #fff;
}
.candy-offer-link:hover .candy-offer-icon{
display: none;
opacity: 0;
}
.candy-offer-link:hover .candy-offer-icon-white{
display: block;
opacity: 1;
}
.candy-offer-menu .col-xl-3{
padding-left: 5px;
padding-right: 5px;
margin-bottom: 10px;
}
@media (max-width: 1480px) {
.candy-offer-box-text{
font-size: 11px;
}
}
@media (max-width: 576px) {
.candy-offer-menu .row{
margin-left: -5px;
margin-right: -5px;
}
.typ-oferty .inner-html h3{
text-align: center;
}
}
